{{Quote|The Bongomeken Collective 'tis not far from here. They haven many bombad subs.|Captain Marsune tells Boss Gallo of the Bongomeken Collective|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''Bongomeken Collective base''' was a base located in the [[Gungan Swamp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that belonged to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] manufacturing company [[Bongomeken Collective]]. Sometime around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3000 BBY]], the Gungan [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]] of [[Otoh Sancture]] sent [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marsune (Gungan)|Marsune]] to the base to get the assistance of the company in [[Raid on Spearhead|defeating]] the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] Boss [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]] by way of donating [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|bongos]] to the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]]. The company agreed and gave Gallo ten bongos. The base consisted of three [[prefab shelter]]s, a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], a [[command center]], two [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], three [[Autoturret/Legends|turrets]], and two [[Power core/Legends|power cores]]. The base was located in a small clearing in a [[Tree/Legends|forest]] next to a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] where the company stored its bongos.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The base made its only appearance in the [[2001]] [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''<ref name="GB" /> and its expansion pack [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. It appeared in the third mission of the Bass [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]] campaign titled "Raid on Spearhead."<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> Though the base is not directly mentioned in the [[Prima Games|Prima]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] for the game, which was released a week prior to the game, the guide does mention that the player must send Marsune to the "Bongomeken Collective."<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
